placements.why: Both segments describe an e2e test-suite assertion and a probe memory built solely to carry that assertion — canonical proof/verification-grain content (testing infrastructure demonstrating a behavioral guarantee), and no strata category exists yet in this repo to hold it.
placements.title: Verification artifacts stand as testable proof of system behavior
placements.frame: Does the content function as a test, probe, or verification artifact whose purpose is to demonstrate or assert a system's actual behavior?

placements.title: Saving a memory is itself the act that confers reviewer standing on its creator
placements.frame: Does the expression treat the act of creating/saving a memory as automatically assigning the creator a reviewer role, and is that invariant being asserted, tested, or relied upon?
placements.why: Src-1 states the governance rule as an e2e-verified invariant (saving enrolls the creator as reviewer); src-2 frames the whole probe memory as existing purely to carry that same assertion — together naming a recurring behavioral-governance subject (creation-triggers-role) that future envelopes in this repo are likely to keep testing and referencing, not a one-off fact.
